title: Non-destructive DNA extraction from DESS preservation solution
author: Eri Ogiso-Tanaka
materials: Sample storage using DESS solution (see Materials page) To transport or store the DNA as undamaged as possible, place the specimen or environmental sample in DESS solution. *Cautions when the sample is an animal Since the DESS solution has low toxicity, animals are not immediately killed when placed in the DESS. It is advisable to kill it somehow before putting the animals into the DESS. This treatment is not particularly necessary for microscopic specimens (e.g. meiofauna). Samples in DESS should be stored in the dark at room temperature (10 ~ 35゜C)

steps.title: Prepare Sample and Binding Buffer
steps.instruction: Transfer X µL (e.g., 500 µL) of DESS supernatant containing the sample to a tube and add 1 volume of Binding buffer (e.g., 500 µL).

substeps.instruction: Binding Buffer composition: 5M Guanidine Thiocyanate, 4% Triton X100, 10% Tween 20, 10mM Sodium acetate
Alternative: Qiagen AL buffer (Catalog #19075) can be used if Binding Buffer is unavailable

steps.title: Mix Sample
steps.instruction: Mix the solution by turning the tube upside-down for 5 minutes at room temperature.

steps.title: Add Silica Solution
steps.instruction: Add 10 µL of silica solution into a new 1.5 mL LoBind tube.

substeps.instruction: Silica solution preparation: mix 2.5g wakosil (FUJIFILM, Cat.#232-00841) in 11mL 0.01N HCl; mix well before aliquoting

steps.title: Initial Centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 9100 x g for 1 minute at 20 °C and discard the supernatant.

steps.title: First Wash
steps.instruction: Add 500 µL of Wash Buffer 1 and mix by vortexing.

substeps.instruction: Wash Buffer 1 composition: Stock buffer and Ethanol in a 1:4 ratio
Stock buffer composition: 10mM TrisHCl pH8.0, 100 mM NaCl, 0.5mM EDTA pH8.0

steps.title: Centrifuge and Discard Wash 1
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 9100 x g for 1 minute at 20 °C and discard the supernatant using a pipette or aspirator.

steps.title: Second Wash
steps.instruction: Add 500 µL of Wash Buffer 2 and mix by vortexing.

steps.title: Centrifuge and Discard Wash 2
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 9100 x g for 1 minute at 20 °C and discard the supernatant using a pipette or aspirator.

steps.title: Final Pellet Wash
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 9100 x g for 1 minute at room temperature and completely discard the supernatant using a pipette or aspirator.

steps.title: Air Dry Pellet
steps.instruction: Air dry for 1 minute at room temperature, ensuring the sample is not over-dried.

steps.title: Elute DNA
steps.instruction: Add 103 µL TE and mix by vortexing.

steps.title: Incubate and Prepare Precipitation Tube
steps.instruction: Incubate the DNA in TE at room temperature for 10 minutes. During this time, prepare a precipitation tube.

substeps.instruction: Prepare a new 1.5 mL LoBind tube
Add 10 µL 3M sodium acetate to the tube

steps.title: Transfer Supernatant
steps.instruction: Transfer 100 µL of the supernatant to the prepared LoBind tube containing sodium acetate and glycogen.

steps.title: Pre-cool Centrifuge
steps.instruction: Cool the centrifuge to -20 °C for approximately 5 minutes.

steps.title: Precipitate DNA
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 20400 x g (max speed) for 30 minutes at 4 °C and discard the supernatant using a pipette or aspirator.

steps.title: Ethanol Wash
steps.instruction: Add 1 mL 75% Ethanol to the tube without mixing.

steps.title: Additional Ethanol Wash
steps.instruction: Add 1 volume of Ethanol (e.g., 500 µL) to the tube.

steps.title: Isopropanol Treatment
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL isopropanol to the tube and mix by vortexing.

steps.title: Centrifuge and Discard Isopropanol
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 20400 x g (max speed) for 1 minute at 4 °C and discard the supernatant using a pipette or aspirator.

steps.title: Final Centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 9100 x g for 1 minute (temperature not specified) and completely discard the supernatant using a pipette or aspirator. A small benchtop centrifuge may be used.

steps.title: Final Air Dry
steps.instruction: Air dry at room temperature in the dark for 10 to 30 minutes. Ensure no ethanol residue remains and do not over-dry.

steps.title: Reconstitute DNA
steps.instruction: Add 10 µL 0.1 TE to the tube and mix by vortexing.

steps.title: Final Incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate for 10 minutes at room temperature in the dark.
